notes.title: The Golden Eyed Ghosts is Out Now-Play Today!
notes.content:
[h3][b]⚔️✨THE GOLDEN EYED GHOSTS IS NOW LIVE!!!⚔️✨[/b][/h3]

As we plunge into the depths of darkness with The Golden Eyed Ghosts, I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to this extraordinary community. Thank you for standing by me during the challenging delays and unforeseen obstacles. Your patience and understanding have meant the world to me, and I am deeply grateful for your unwavering support.

[b]Being a small indie studio, I understand the mighty power of your commitment to my game. If you would like to help, you can do so by:[/b]
[list]
[*]Share the odyssey with your family, friends, and even your beloved streamers.
[*][b]Harness the Power of Reviews: [/b]Once you've ventured through the macabre kingdom, consider leaving a review on Steam. Your reviews illuminate the way for future adventurers, and your feedback helps me further refine the game.
[*][b]Social Media Squad:[/b] Share the dark tales and recount your harrowing adventures with fellow explorers on social media. Let the world bear witness to the sinister wonders of Andromeda and the life-changing decisions you've made.
[/list]
But remember, there's no pressure! I am just genuinely thrilled to have you here with me, whether you're conversing about the game here on Steam, in the Discord, or vanquishing the abyssal horrors that await.

[h3][b]Play The Golden Eyed Ghosts Now [/b][/h3]
[i]Buy it in the first week of launch and save 20%!![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1950930/The_Golden_Eyed_Ghosts/

The Golden Eyed Ghosts is a dark fantasy souls-like adventure heavily influenced by the legacy of Zelda. Set in the crumbling kingdom of Andromeda, you take on the mantle of exiled warrior Orion, seeking to unravel a bone-chilling conspiracy and recover the four legendary stolen swords to save the kingdom from certain doom.

Beneath the kingdom's surface, ancient, macabre secrets lurk, threatening its very existence. Decisions dictate the way forward. Will you slash your way through or seek a cunning approach? Will you harvest life energy or seek solace among strangely familiar grindstones? The choices you make in combat are just the beginning, as they will ripple through this crumbling kingdom, forging alliances or betrayals.

Are you prepared to confront eldritch energies, sinister forests, glittering icefields, murky bogs, and decaying cities? The fate of Andromeda hangs in the balance, and it's up to you to decide whether to let it succumb to madness or stand tall and save this realm from certain doom.

I can't wait for you to descend further into the abyss of Andromeda. If you come across any bugs or have valuable feedback, I'd love to hear from you! Join the [url=http://discord.gg/T2AnJHwmak]official Discord[/url] community and follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/GEGgame]Twitter[/url] for the latest updates. 

See you in Andromeda, fellow Adventurers! 
The Dev Team 🗡️🛡️

 [h3][b]Forge your own destiny:[/b][/h3] Will you charge headfirst into battle or seek a more cunning approach? Harness the life energy of your foes or seek solace in the enigmatic grindstones? Mix and match Orion's abilities to conquer any adversary that crosses your path! 🛡️

Are you ready to confront eldritch energies, sinister forests, glittering icefields, murky bogs, and decaying cities? The fate of Andromeda hangs in the balance, and it's up to you to decide whether to let it succumb to madness or stand tall and save this realm from certain doom.

notes.title: Demo Update & PAX East recap
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We were at PAX East with our publisher, Freedom Games, this weekend just gone and it was amazing to see people enjoy the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/df05a44ee879333ec19aab6c718e13ee34ef7b6b.jpg[/img]

Thank you to everyone who came to check us out and to everyone who has been enjoying The Golden Eyes Ghosts’s demo so far!

The demo has been brought up to date from last year, with several improvements and changes that I've been working on during development! In the updated demo, there will be:

[list]
[*] Updated player controls
[*] Overhauled animations for Orion
[*] Better enemy AI
[*] Updated tutorials
[*] Better level scaling and difficulty balance
[*] Updated UI
[*] Visual overhaul of enemies
[*] Several bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/2326c97c46b263831be0ff1dfce2d7a558deb077.jpg[/img]

If you want more updates, make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/GEGgame]Twitter[/url]! Don’t forget - there are some events going on in the [url=http://discord.gg/T2AnJHwmak]Discord[/url] over the next month or two to accompany the [url=http://kck.st/3Te1SW6]Kickstarter[/url]. Join the server so you can participate!

Thanks again for all of your support. Any feedback or bug reports are greatly appreciated. Hope you enjoy!

Until next time, questers!

Syphono4

notes.title: March Update + Kickstarter is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

It’s been 48 hours since our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thegoldeneyedghosts/the-golden-eyed-ghosts?utm_source=Kickstarter&utm_medium=KS_GEG_SteamUpdate&utm_id=GEG_Crowdfunding]Kickstarter[/url] launched! I’m so grateful for your support of it. As a solo first-time developer, it's been a dream of mine to make my own game and I'm finally working full-time to make that dream come true! Thank you all for helping make that happen.

To celebrate our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thegoldeneyedghosts/the-golden-eyed-ghosts?utm_source=Kickstarter&utm_medium=KS_GEG_SteamUpdate&utm_id=GEG_Crowdfunding]Kickstarter[/url] kickoff, here’s a peek at two of the bosses you’ll be dispatching throughout the game + our [b]new[/b] trailer! 

[previewyoutube=Pgf_tQfnIfM;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/f87c8fbfbeac7692afe2b1b3d35543374f3eeaf6.gif[/img]
This is Deathstalker. Not only does he have a melee attack with his hands, you have to watch out for his tail, too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/1e74bdaf139d1371995a7fbefe7ffd9fc2a5e880.gif[/img]

I’ve been working hard at finalizing their movesets to give you the best combat experience, so if you want more updates, make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/GEGgame]Twitter[/url]! Don’t forget - there are some events going on in the [url=http://discord.gg/T2AnJHwmak]Discord[/url] over the next month or two to accompany the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thegoldeneyedghosts/the-golden-eyed-ghosts?utm_source=Kickstarter&utm_medium=KS_GEG_SteamUpdate&utm_id=GEG_Crowdfunding]Kickstarter[/url]. Join the server so you can participate in our Lore Drop Mondays, an Art Contest, and a special giveaway!

Thanks again for all of your support. I can’t wait for you to explore Andromeda with me!

Until next time, questers!

Syphono4

notes.title: TGEG Steam Monthly Update - Sept-Dec 2022
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I have tons of news to share! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/48e327d574ea4f7aa85d7f949ce983c68376e4e4.gif[/img]

First of all in September, we were at PAX West in Seattle, as well as the PAX Steam event! Lots of people got a sneak peek at the game, and I received some valuable feedback for development. We’re super excited to welcome new community members who saw us there!

As part of the PAX event, we also released the Premier Trailer for The Golden Eyed Ghosts. You can check it out here!

[previewyoutube=v2iP-jm0kTE;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you enjoy it!

Next, we participated in EGX London from September 22-25! This was another exciting event that gave even more people a chance to check us out. We received a lot of great feedback from the community at both events and we’re super excited to show everyone what we’ve been up to!

As for development, I’m still settling into working as a developer full time, and it’s been going great! I’m still processing that I’m getting to live my dream of making my own game, and it’s been really fun. 

In other news, we’ve also pre-launched our Kickstarter! This is a huge step in supporting my dream of developing full time. If you’d like, check out the page here:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thegoldeneyedghosts/the-golden-eyed-ghosts]Kickstarter Link![/url]

We also participated in the Indie Live Expo Steam Event earlier this month, which was a great help in getting more eyes on the game!

In these past few months, there has been tons of progress with the game, with lots of enemies, bosses and areas designed and implemented in the game. 

In line with community feedback, we’ve created some new battle animations! Check out this comparison.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/114e901b8c3579f4eff574c5b51e3909e5b25771.gif[/img]

Here’s a look at the new in-game animations in action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/b2d61dbee9b7c07e9b4d87d0bb086f026214a990.gif[/img]

Take a look at some other characters you can see in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/b0a2c0efd9858a17f17c9bf96cad70eba89d5acb.gif[/img]

I can’t wait for you all to try it out when it’s ready!

To keep up to date with further updates, you can check us out [url=https://twitter.com/GEGgame]Twitter [/url]and [url=http://discord.gg/T2AnJHwmak]Discord[/url].

As always, see you next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346905/d4ff425c8ad621da71d7bd832143771edd20b084.gif[/img]

Signed,
The dev team
